profile.headline: Business Strategy Planner/Creator/Producer of the Everborn Universe
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Client-focused IT professional with 10+ years of technical experience in the Finance Industry and 10+ years of experience in sales/marketing leadership positions. 

Proven success in software administration and data communications to bring to an innovative organization dedicated to excellence. 

Diverse training experience and skills to motivate peak individual performance from team members while driving sustained forward growth momentum.

The founder of R-Squared Entertainment and Lead Writer and Creative Director of all things related to the Everborn Universe. 

Successfully launched and manage content for three interconnected comic series of which the Everborn Saga is comprised. 

Manages a GLOBAL team of artists to produce comics video games and other content for the Everborn customers and fans.

Manages Commerces channels (Including EverbornSaga.com) Publishing Partners and Print Distribution 

Responsible for two successful Kickstarters, both funded within the first 24hrs.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities

Collaborate with the Product Team to Analyze Key Performance Indicators of our Client facing Applications

Liaison with Cloud Vendors (AWS) to Solution Strategies for a Migration to the Cloud 

Working with Stakeholders and Partners to solve Complex Business Problems

Provide technology leadership, ownership, and accountability on large projects

Analyze, craft, and implement new features/functionality primarily using the following technologies: C#, .NET, WPF, XML, AngularJS, ASP.NET, Entity Framework

Work on multiple projects and manage time effectively

Participate in requirement gathering process, propose solutions, and create design documents

Provide timely and accurate communication of status to teams, project, and technical leads

Gather requirements, design, code, test, and implement according to design specifications
positions.insights: Skills: Product Life Cycle · Competitive Analysis · Conflict Resolution · Decision-Making · Strategic Thinking · Microsoft Products · Project Management · Key Performance Indicators · Business Agility · Stakeholder Management · Data Analysis · Business Relationship Management · Technical Communication · Influencing Others

positions.title: Founder/Writer/Creator/Producer/Game Designer/Lead Programmer
positions.description:
The founder of R-Squared Entertainment and Lead Writer and Creative Director of all things related to the Everborn Universe. 

Successfully launched and manage content for three interconnected comic series of which the Everborn Saga is comprised. 

Manages a GLOBAL team of artists to produce comics video games and other content for the Everborn customers and fans.

Manages Commerces channels (Including EverbornSaga.com) Publishing Partners and Print Distribution 

Responsible for two successful Kickstarters, both funded within the first 24hrs.

Responsible for application/game development, game architecture, concept, design, and prototyping, testing, and optimization

Successfully released the Game Star Tennis on the iOS and WP7/8 platforms

Currently in Development active Development of Everborn: Ariel's Adventure
positions.insights: Skills: Product Life Cycle · Creativity and Innovation · Competitive Analysis · Product Management · Conflict Resolution · Decision-Making · Strategic Thinking · Microsoft Products · Project Management · Key Performance Indicators · Business Agility · Stakeholder Management · Data Analysis · Business Relationship Management · Technical Communication · Customer Research · Storytelling · Influencing Others

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Used SQL to analyze large datasets to Identify KPIs and find Actionable Insights

Led Dev-Ops effort to promote and achieve automated testing and single-click deployment 

Developed multiple single-page applications and client-facing webpages utilizing Angular2/4/5, with Ngxs for state management and Material Design with back ends built in .Net, Node, and Java (spring-boot) 	      

Implemented complex business logic into SQL Server queries/stored procedures 

Developed a tool to proactively warn users of Citi’s Citi-Manager platform in the event of potential data breaches.

Utilized Talend ETL tool along with Java to develop files with complex business logic for Citi’s TTS Cards clients.

Regularly Collaborated with offshore teams to redesign PAA (P&L Attribute Analysis) system consisting of Autosys Jobs, .Net application to parse data and SQL tables / stored procedures 

Completed Design and Requirement documents for large projects

Helped transition from a Monolithic to Micro Service model for data retrieval
positions.insights: Skills: Product Life Cycle · Competitive Analysis · Conflict Resolution · Decision-Making · Strategic Thinking · Microsoft Products · Key Performance Indicators · Business Agility · Stakeholder Management · Data Analysis · Technical Communication · Influencing Others

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Provided service and support to clients and senior executives on Windows platform and desktop application-related issues. 

Determined source and nature of computer malfunction using diagnostic and application software by adjusting, repairing, and replacing malfunctioning equipment on a need basis. 

Installed hardware and software to new or existing user workstations (using imaging software) while ensuring full functionality on network, printer, and application connections. 

Performed subsequent workstation moves, adds, or changes as requested. 

Troubleshot and resolved hardware issues related to MACs, PCs, iPads, iPhones, laptops, Blackberry handheld devices, black and white/color printers, and copy machines. 

Maintained detailed documentation with respect to end-user problems on diagnosis and resolutions for future reference (SMS Remote Control, Touch Paper) and for use as a resource tool in identifying ongoing or recurring issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Conflict Resolution · Microsoft Products · Business Agility · Data Analysis · Influencing Others

positions.title: Summer Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for application development 

Worked extensively in Linux environment.

Collaborated other analysts as well as teams from the UK, India, and China to standardize the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana) board rollout at Citi.

Configured the ELK stack on multiple machines using different technologies including creating bash scripts to automate the entire deployment process

Integrated an ELK stack into my team in order to analyzed their log files, effectively reducing several workflows from 20-30 minutes down to sub-seconds.
positions.insights: Skills: Business Agility · Data Analysis · Technical Communication · Influencing Others

positions.title: Owner, Real Estate Broker
positions.description:
Responsible for developing various sales strategies and techniques in order to market to appropriate individuals and corporations

Successfully maintain and manage multiple property listings on an on-going basis

Continuously promote apartment listings by utilizing various internet marketing tools such as Craigslist

Identify new ‘listings’ on a weekly basis

Meet with potential buyers & renters in an attempt to gain their business and guide them through the home buying and/or renting process 

Meet with landlords and other building representatives in order to sell and promote Folbs Realty 

Responsible for negotiating lease and other contractual terms in order to serve as an effective mediator to both owners and buyers/renters

Developed creative methods in order to maintain a competitive advantage among other realtors
positions.insights: Skills: Competitive Analysis · Conflict Resolution · Decision-Making · Strategic Thinking · Business Agility · Data Analysis · Business Relationship Management · Customer Research · Influencing Others

positions.title: Associate Real Estate Broker
positions.description:
On-Site Leases Agent For Several New Development Buildings in Williamsburg including 525 Union, 285 Driggs, and 234 Green Avenue  

Responsible for ‘meeting and greeting’ potential buyers & renters in an attempt to gain their business and guide them through the home buying and/or renting process  

Effectively maintained a monthly quota of 5-7 rentals for organization
